params.name: page
params.description: Page number (default: 1)

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of items per page (default: 25, max: 50)

params.name: search
params.description:
Case-insensitive substring filter for campaign names.
- Example: 'training' matches 'Security Training'

params.name: flow_types
params.description:
Filter by campaign flow type IDs.
- `1` = Training Only - Filter for campaigns that only include training content
- `2` = Simulation and Training - Filter for campaigns that include both phishing simulation and training

params.name: locale_ids
params.description:
Filter by locale IDs.
- Use numeric identifiers from the locale catalog

params.name: statuses
params.description:
Filter by campaign status codes.
- `0` = Draft - Filter for campaigns in draft state
- `1` = Collecting (Active) - Filter for campaigns actively collecting participant data
- `2` = Completed - Filter for campaigns that have finished
- `3` = Pending - Filter for campaigns approved but waiting to start
- `4` = Active - Filter for campaigns currently running
- `5` = Inactive - Filter for inactive campaigns

params.name: scheduled_date_from
params.description:
Earliest campaign schedule date (inclusive).
- Format: MM-DD-YYYY
- Cannot be combined with `scheduled_time_from` / `scheduled_time_to`.

params.name: scheduled_date_to
params.description:
Latest campaign schedule date (inclusive).
- Format: MM-DD-YYYY
- Cannot be combined with `scheduled_time_from` / `scheduled_time_to`.

params.name: scheduled_time_from
params.description:
Earliest campaign schedule timestamp (inclusive).
- Format: ISO 8601 datetime (e.g., `2026-03-01T00:00:00Z`)
- Cannot be combined with `scheduled_date_from` / `scheduled_date_to`.

params.name: scheduled_time_to
params.description:
Latest campaign schedule timestamp (inclusive).
- Format: ISO 8601 datetime (e.g., `2026-03-31T23:59:59Z`)
- Cannot be combined with `scheduled_date_from` / `scheduled_date_to`.

Retrieve a paginated list of call for action pages available for the specified company. The endpoint returns system pages, public pages, company-owned pages, and brand owner pages (if the company is part of a brand). Results can be filtered by search term.

Scopes:
  • company.view
  • partner.company.view

info.name: Get landing pages for a company.

params.name: locale_ids
params.description:
Filter by locale IDs.
- Use numeric identifiers from the locale catalog
- If not provided, company's selected locales will be used

params.name: created_by
params.description:
Filter by created by codes.
- `1` = System
- `2` = Company
- `3` = MSP
- Provide one or both codes

Retrieve campaign setup and settings data for the specified company. This endpoint provides configuration data needed for campaign creation and management, including license limits, training content vendors, default content templates, and company settings. Scopes:

params.name: created_by
params.description:
Filter by template creator codes.
- `1` = System - Templates provided by the system
- `2` = Company - Templates owned by the current company
- `3` = MSP - Templates provided by the MSP
- `4` = Community - Community-contributed templates
- Provide one or more codes

params.name: locale_ids
params.description:
Filter by locale IDs.
- Use numeric identifiers from the locale catalog
- If not provided, company's selected locales will be used

params.name: type
params.description:
Filter by template type codes.
- `0` = Drive-by (links)
- `1` = Attachment
- `2` = Call for Action

params.name: category_ids
params.description: Filter by template category (scenario group) IDs. - Use endpoint /appapi/sat/{company_id}/templates/categories/ to get the list of available categories

params.name: level
params.description:
Array of integers
Filter by template level (difficulty) codes.
- `0` = Beginner
- `1` = Intermediate
- `2` = Advanced

params.name: sort
params.description:
Field to sort templates by:
- `last_updated` - Sort by last updated date
- `name` - Sort by template name
- `avg_click_rate` - Sort by average click rate (per selected locales)
- `avg_reported_rate` - Sort by average reported rate (per selected locales)

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order: `asc` for ascending, `desc` for descending
